facts.fact: The FDSU runs a National Strategy for Universal Connectivity 2026-2035 to extend telecoms access in rural and peri-urban areas, with a phase 0 of 40 pilot sites and a phase 1 of about 300 sites in five zones, selected by a scoring framework.
facts.system: Stratégie Nationale pour la Connectivité Universelle

systems.system: Fonds de Développement du Service Universel (FDSU)
